sentence: \paragraph{Generative model of one pseudo-experiment.} Each calibration pseudo-experiment splits the simulation at random into two halves (Table~\ref{tab:joint5d-genmodel}) and refits the background refinement. Its truth equals $G$ on every fine cell that the source half populates. Cells it leaves empty lower a coarse cell by at most \SI{0.2}{\percent}, or about \SI{4}{\percent} of the null standard deviation (the per-experiment spread is below \SI{1.5}{\percent} of it). On the signal, each interaction-model band is renormalized within each fine truth cell, so it moves only the composition within the cell, and with it the efficiency and the migrations. The flux universe is drawn uniformly from the \jtFluxUniverses{} universes. In each calibration pseudo-experiment, the flux universe and the band universes are drawn independently, and their weight ratios multiply. Each interaction-model band is drawn independently and uniformly from its own universes, either endpoint of a $\pm1\sigma$ pair or one of three where a band has three, and the weight ratios multiply. Negative weights in two of those bands are clipped per universe (\S\ref{sec:joint5d-conditions}). Each weight-based detector band is at its $-1\sigma$ or $+1\sigma$ endpoint with equal probability. The muon-energy, muon-resolution, and beam-angle lateral bands enter as $\sum_{b}z_{b}\Delta_{b}$. Each $z_{b}$ is an independent standard normal. For each band, $\Delta_{b}$ is half the difference of the unfolded cell values from that band's two real-data endpoint unfolds. The coefficient of the \SI{1.4}{\percent} normalization is an independent standard normal.

sentence: The data's rounding noise, and the prediction's finite-sample error, are added as a normal draw in each cell. The prediction's variance in that draw is its own per-cell sum of squared weights. That diagonal model is an assumption of the metric. Disjoint cells do not by themselves make a prediction's Monte Carlo errors independent. The background source and its template are Poisson draws from disjoint halves of the background sample. The detector weight bands include the GEANT4 hadron-interaction reweights.
